My Dearest Thangamaeyyy,

Happy Birthday to the queen of my heart! 🎂 ✨

Words fall short when I try to express how much you mean to me. Since you walked into my life, everything has felt brighter, warmer, and so much more alive.

Every little laugh, every silly moment, every quiet conversation with you — I fall for you all over again. Today is your day, but honestly, my whole heart belongs to you every single day of the year.

I hope this year hands you everything you deserve: joy that never runs dry, dreams that quietly come true, and a love that only keeps growing — mine, for you.

Happy Birthday Santhiya, my Thangamaeyyy. I love you dii pondati, endlessly.
